name: LockLyrics
tagline: Real-time synced lyrics on your lock screen with LRCLIB, lrc.red, Musixmatch & SpicyLyrics support!

changelog.changes: Added SpicyLyrics provider support (developers.spicylyrics.org API key) with syllable and line level sync.

Initial release: Real-time synced lock screen lyrics with LRCLIB, lrc.red, and Musixmatch support, MediaRemote true elapsed-time synchronization, customizable positioning, and live draggable interface.
